reels.title: Why 14-Month-Old Ojas Spent 25 Minutes Focused On This Wooden Sorter Cube!

playTestingNotes.observedBehavior: Ojas first attempted to fit the square block into the triangular hole. After 3 tries, he rotated the block, aligned the angle, and dropped it in. Displayed spontaneous clapping upon success.
playTestingNotes.parentSafetyCheck: Pass - Non-toxic vegetable paint, 0 small part choking hazards

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Ultra close-up of Ojas' tiny fingers dropping a wooden cylinder into the slot with a satisfying crisp *CLACK* sound.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: Stop spending ₹1,500 on battery-operated noisy toys your toddler ignores after 2 days!

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Side-by-side split screen showing a dusty plastic flashing keyboard vs Ojas deeply engrossed in turning the wooden cube.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: At 14 months, Ojas doesn't need flashing lights. He needs spatial reasoning and pincer grip practice.

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Medium shot of Ojas turning the triangle block, struggling for 2 seconds, then discovering the right slot. Quick cut to his beaming smile.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: Watch how he rotates the triangle. This trial-and-error builds early problem-solving pathways in the brain.

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Parent holding the Ravet Parent Toy Exchange app on phone screen next to the real wooden cube on the play mat.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: Instead of buying this ₹1,300 Shumee cube, we got it from a parent right here in Ravet Sector 29 for 15 exchange coins!
scriptBreakdown.onScreenText: ₹1,300 retail vs Free Exchange in Ravet 📍

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Ojas waving goodbye while holding the cube, with animated arrow pointing to the bio link / comment prompt.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: Comment 'SORTER' below to get the direct Ravet Exchange link and borrow it for your toddler today!

reels.title: Magnetic Building Tiles: How Ojas Learned 3D Balance at 18 Months!

playTestingNotes.observedBehavior: Ojas loved sticking tiles against the sunlight window to create colorful shadows, then stacked 4 tiles vertically before knocked them down with delight.
playTestingNotes.parentSafetyCheck: Pass - Ultrasonic welded edges with metal rivets, magnets sealed tight

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Sunlight streaming through colorful magnetic tiles on the glass window as Ojas snaps a purple triangle into place with a loud *SNAP*.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: This one toy replaced 5 expensive activity boxes for Ojas!

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Ojas holding the tiles up to his eyes, looking through red and blue translucent filters at the camera.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: Buying ₹2,500 magnetic sets can hurt your budget, especially when kids change interests every month.

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Time-lapse of Ojas building a mini 3D cube tower with parent encouragement, then laughing as it collapses.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: At 18 months, building up and knocking down teaches gravity, magnetism, and emotional resilience when structures break!

reels.title: Gear Turning Board: Building Cause & Effect Motor Skills with Ojas!

playTestingNotes.observedBehavior: Ojas figured out that spinning one main red handle turns 6 other gears simultaneously. Fascinated by the continuous motion.
playTestingNotes.parentSafetyCheck: Pass - Wooden pegs firmly attached, non-removable small gears

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Super smooth spinning macro of 7 rainbow gears turning together as Ojas turns one peg.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: Turn one gear, and watch what happens to all six!

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Ojas removing one gear and discovering the chain breaks.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: This simple wooden gear board teaches mechanical cause-and-effect way better than any screen app.

scriptBreakdown.visualScene: Ojas re-aligning gear teeth to repair the chain.
scriptBreakdown.audioVoiceover: Notice how he aligns the teeth! That requires micro-adjustments of wrists and fingers.
